profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Dedicate to front-end space!

- 6 years software development experience.
- Strong basis in data structure, algorithm, and computer science fundamentals.
- Solid  knowledge of Javascript/ES6, CSS, and HTML.
- Hands-on experience in modern front-end development frameworks (React & Vue)
- Experience with both SPA and web development.
- Familiar with node.js, npm, REST, Ajax, MongoDB, jQuery, Redux, and responsive design.
- Comfortable with asynchronous programing. 
- Strong work ethic and willing to learn new technologies to find out best solution.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed an interface adapter which could access into China Financial Futures Exchange by using CTP (Comprehensive Transaction Platform) API.

•Improved the QA procedure by developing a command line tool which allowed QA testers to more easily and efficiently to do integration tests on the platform.

• Maintained the front end of current product, a trading platform, to keep the GUI working stably, correctly and smoothly.

projects.title: Wireless Router Deployment Strategy Generator
projects.description:
Automatically generated the wireless router deployment plan for building. Provided optimal solution according to every floor plans from input.

1. Utilized Genetic Algorithm to develop a wireless router deployment strategy with Java.
2. Reduced 2.6% router dependency compared with original scheme.
